_note: Svelte-4 comma-separated reactive-dependency idiom `$: a, b, c, expr`. `svelte-check --tsgo` reports TS2695 ("Left side of comma operator is unused") for each bare-identifier dep — the default engine's `resolveNoopsInReactiveStatements` filter needs the language service, which the tsgo command never runs — and so do we. An earlier version rewrote the commas to semicolons at emit and reported nothing.
